description: A live reactive review selected a welcome action but failed the whole cycle with invalid_participation_image_proposal. Optional image-generation metadata must be discarded or converted to a text-only proposal when it is invalid. The event must reach one durable terminal state without a duplicate job or external effect. Add regression tests for reactive and proactive cycles.

comments.text: Fixed in commit dbb76ba. Invalid or action-incompatible optional image fields are removed before decision validation. Reactive welcome and proactive post regressions prove a normal text action reaches one durable terminal state, calls no image generator, creates no protocol effect, and is not selected twice. Verification: mix compile --warnings-as-errors; 414 tests passed.

title: Do not fail participation when an optional image proposal is invalid
